in_greek.name: Ρούμπι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ρούμπι προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για το ρουμπίνι, έναν πολύτιμο λίθο κόκκινου χρώματος. Το ρουμπίνι θεωρείται σύμβολο αγάπης, πάθους και δύναμης. Στην ιστορία, τα ρουμπίνια έχουν συσχετιστεί με την πλούτο και την εξουσία.

The name Rubie has been used in various Christian cultures, reflecting the gemstone's significance and beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rubie is of Latino origin and is often used as a feminine variation of the name Ruben or Rubeus. In various cultures, it evokes images of beautiful red roses, the fiery passions of the Latin people, or the vibrant colors and flavors of Latin American cuisine and art.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Rubie is symbolic of the deep and passionate love that God has for His children. It also represents God's protection and strength, like a ruby gemstone that guards and preserves the wearer. Additionally, the name can serve as a reminder of the redemption and newness of life that comes through Jesus Christ. Ultimately, the name Rubie encourages us to live our lives with passion and zeal, modeling God's love and redemptive power to those around us.
